description: Enforced field set, the mode and protected_paths_check enums, and the permitted action vocabulary for the portable vibe-code session contract. Single source read by scripts/validate_vibe_code_session.py; the prose vibe-code-session.schema.md describes intent and rules and does not restate these lists. Procedural rules (mode/action compatibility, authorized-write path requirement, per-phase and per-receipt evidence, the open-question gate, the reproduction rule for a defect fix) stay in the validator.
